# Upgrade forwarding with HTTP/1.1 in one location enables H2C smuggling.
# Both directive triples sit in a single block, so each ordering fires.
location /api {
    # ruleid: possible-nginx-h2c-smuggling
    proxy_http_version 1.1 ;
    # ruleid: possible-nginx-h2c-smuggling
    # ruleid: possible-nginx-h2c-smuggling
    proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade ;
    proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade" ;
    proxy_http_version 1.1 ;
    proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade ;
    proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade" ;
}
# ok: possible-nginx-h2c-smuggling
location /static {
    root /var/www;
}
# ok: possible-nginx-h2c-smuggling
expires 30d;
